title: F126.2 the file and the grading: the overview
caption: Four parts and nothing else: a reader that takes one eval file into records, a schema made from those records, seven facts that code tells from a transcript, and one judge that marks a criterion. No API, no page and no stored run.

cards.title: F126.2 The file and the grading
cards.code: no API, no page, no stored run
cards.text: The first new code of the evals: what an eval file holds, and how one turn of a conversation gets its marks.

cards.title: The file is read
cards.text: One .eval.json becomes records. A wrong file is refused at its first fault, with its place.

cards.title: The schema is made
cards.text: Made from the records and kept as a golden file, so Rider helps while you write an eval.

cards.title: Code tells the facts
cards.text: Seven things a transcript shows for certain and for free, such as which tool was called.

cards.title: A judge marks the rest
cards.text: One model call for one criterion: yes or no, with the reason, as a typed record.
